message: Removed the single-slot reconciliation bottleneck observed after V15 rollout. Legacy reconciliation now exposes six additional objective-family scheduler-reconciler slots so fresh Go workers have claimable state-only work while the original reconciliation owner continues. Green CI alone is not completion; workers should advance a claimable shard or another scheduler recommendation and only idle after reconciliation plus a refreshed empty queue.

data.reason: fresh Go workers were exiting after observing green V15/CI because the only reconciliation slot was already owned and the V15 queue had not yet been populated
